crop.notes: Now includes the Mace/Allen paragraph from the same column (merged from the old 906 and 907).

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic, St. Louis, Sunday Morning, February 24, 1895, page 11. Dateline New York, Feb. 22.

facts.fact: Billy Delaney said Jem Mace, close to 60, wanted to come to America to fight Allen again after being told Allen claimed he could whip him; Mace also wanted a bout with Bill Clark

notes: Rewritten after merge and hand transcript. Most of the column is about Corbett and Fitzsimmons; Allen appears in one paragraph. Correspondent doubts Allen would do better than he did against Mace 25 years earlier.
